claims.disproof_condition: 條件：日東紡下一份有価証券報告書（約 2027-06）的「重要な契約等」不再列這份委託契約，或日東紡、南亞的一手寫出委託終止或縮減。核查頻率：每年（日東紡有報，6 月）＋每季（日東紡決算説明資料「南亜プラスチックとの協業」那一行）。觸發後 48 小時：e1 加註或降 confidence，重讀日東紡敘事「量從哪裡來」那一句與特殊玻璃布的供給側。
claims.statement: Nitto Boseki's annual securities report for the fiscal year ended 2026-03-31 (EDINET S100YDBM, filed 2026-06-18), section 'Important contracts': a product manufacturing consignment contract with 南亜塑膠工業股份有限公司 (Nan Ya Plastics Corporation, Taiwan), signed 2025-11-28, contract content 'weaving manufacturing consignment of special glass cloth' (スペシャルガラスクロスの織布製造委託). This is the consignor's (buyer's) own statutory disclosure. Nittobo's FY2026 Q1 results presentation (2026-08-05, p.16) lists '南亜プラスチックとの協業（織布工程）' in its special-glass capacity plan. The filing states no volume, no contract term, no exclusivity, and not which special glass (NE or T) is woven.
